title: Lunar New Year 2026
topic_titles: []
---

The 2nd Annual Lunar New Year Celebration will take place on February 21, 2026, from 10 a.m. to 1 p.m. at the Burien Community Center, located at 14700 6th Ave SW in Burien, Washington. This year, the event is moving to a larger venue to accommodate more attendees. The celebration is free and community-led, with support from the City of Burien and Discover Burien. Festivities will include lion and Vietnamese dance performances, arts and crafts activities, story time, a fashion show, and complimentary bites. Everyone is invited to join in the festivities and celebrate the Lunar New Year together, marking a new community tradition in Burien.
